# discord_auto_moderation_rule (Resource)

Manages a server AutoMod rule. Requires the Manage Server permission, and Moderate Members for a `timeout` action.

A server can have up to 6 `keyword` rules and one rule of each other trigger type. Discord creates a `mention_spam` rule in Community servers; import it to manage it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_auto_moderation_rule" "scams" {
  server_id    = var.server_id
  name         = "Block scam links"
  event_type   = "message_send"
  trigger_type = "keyword"
  enabled      = true

  trigger_metadata = {
    keyword_filter = ["free nitro", "*giveaway*"]
    regex_patterns = ["disc[o0]rd-?gift"]
    allow_list     = ["giveaway-winners"]
  }

  actions = [
    { type = "block_message", custom_message = "Scam links are not allowed." },
    { type = "send_alert_message", channel_id = var.mod_log_channel_id },
    { type = "timeout", duration_seconds = 3600 },
  ]

  exempt_role_ids = [var.moderator_role_id]
}

resource "discord_auto_moderation_rule" "presets" {
  server_id    = var.server_id
  name         = "Block slurs and sexual content"
  event_type   = "message_send"
  trigger_type = "keyword_preset"
  enabled      = true

  trigger_metadata = {
    presets = ["sexual_content", "slurs"]
  }

  actions = [{ type = "block_message" }]
}

resource "discord_auto_moderation_rule" "profiles" {
  server_id    = var.server_id
  name         = "Quarantine impersonators"
  event_type   = "member_update"
  trigger_type = "member_profile"
  enabled      = true

  trigger_metadata = {
    keyword_filter = ["*moderator*", "*admin*"]
  }

  actions = [{ type = "block_member_interaction" }]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes List) Actions taken when the rule triggers (1-5). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `event_type` (String) When the rule is checked: `message_send` when a member sends or edits a message, or `member_update` when a member edits their profile, which `member_profile` rules check.
- `name` (String) Rule name (1-100 characters).
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).
- `trigger_type` (String) What triggers the rule: `keyword`, `spam`, `keyword_preset`, `mention_spam`, `member_profile`. `keyword` checks content for the configured keywords and patterns, `spam` for generic spam, `keyword_preset` for Discord's word lists, `mention_spam` for too many unique mentions, and `member_profile` checks member profiles for keywords. Changing it replaces the rule.

### Optional

- `audit_log_reason` (String) Reason recorded in the server's audit log for changes this resource makes, overriding the provider's `audit_log_reason`. Up to 512 characters. Changing only this argument updates state without calling Discord.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled. Defaults to `false`, as in Discord.
- `exempt_channel_ids` (Set of String) IDs of channels the rule does not apply to (up to 50).
- `exempt_role_ids` (Set of String) IDs of roles the rule does not apply to (up to 20).
- `trigger_metadata` (Attributes) Settings of the trigger. Each trigger type uses only some of the fields: `keyword` and `member_profile` use `keyword_filter`, `regex_patterns` and `allow_list`; `keyword_preset` uses `presets` and `allow_list`; `mention_spam` uses `mention_total_limit` and `mention_raid_protection_enabled`; `spam` uses none. Lists left out are cleared, while left-out mention settings keep their current values. Leave the whole argument unset to keep Discord's current settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trigger_metadata))

### Read-Only

- `creator_id` (String) ID of the user that created the rule.
- `id` (String) Rule ID.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `type` (String) Action: `block_message` blocks the message, `send_alert_message` logs the content to `channel_id`, `timeout` times the member out for `duration_seconds` (only for `keyword` and `mention_spam` rules), and `block_member_interaction` stops the member from using text, voice and other interactions.

Optional:

- `channel_id` (String) Channel `send_alert_message` logs to. Required for that action.
- `custom_message` (String) Explanation shown to the member when `block_message` blocks their message (up to 150 characters).
- `duration_seconds` (Number) Length of a `timeout` in seconds, up to `2419200` (4 weeks). Required for that action.


<a id="nestedatt--trigger_metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trigger_metadata`

Optional:

- `allow_list` (Set of String) Keywords that do not trigger the rule, matched like `keyword_filter` (each up to 60 characters; up to 100 for `keyword` and `member_profile` rules, 1000 for `keyword_preset` rules).
- `keyword_filter` (Set of String) Keywords to match (up to 1000, each up to 60 characters). A keyword can be a phrase. A leading or trailing `*` matches it as a prefix, suffix or anywhere in a word; without one it must be a whole word. Matching is case insensitive.
- `mention_raid_protection_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to detect sudden spikes in mentions that indicate a mention raid.
- `mention_total_limit` (Number) Most unique role and user mentions allowed in a message (up to 50).
- `presets` (Set of String) Discord word lists to match: `profanity`, `sexual_content`, `slurs`.
- `regex_patterns` (Set of String) Rust-flavored regular expressions to match (up to 10, each up to 260 characters).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_auto_moderation_rule.scams
  identity = {
    server_id = "234567890123456789"
    rule_id   = "969707018069872670"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `rule_id` (String) ID of the AutoMod rule.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_auto_moderation_rule.scams <server_id>/<rule_id>
```
